events.title: HMS Beagle Reaches the Galápagos Islands
events.description: HMS Beagle, carrying naturalist Charles Darwin during its second survey voyage, arrived at the Galápagos Islands in the Pacific Ocean. Darwin spent about five weeks studying the geology, flora, and fauna of the archipelago.
events.significance: Darwin's observations of variations among species such as finches and tortoises on different islands helped shape his later theory of evolution by natural selection, published in On the Origin of Species in 1859.

events.title: First Use of Tanks in Warfare
events.description: During the Battle of the Somme at Flers-Courcelette, British forces deployed Mark I tanks for the first time in combat, using them to support infantry attacks against German lines.
events.significance: Although the early tanks were mechanically unreliable, their debut marked a turning point in military technology and eventually transformed modern armored warfare.

events.title: Nuremberg Laws Enacted in Nazi Germany
events.description: At the annual Nazi Party rally in Nuremberg, the Reichstag passed the Reich Citizenship Law and the Law for the Protection of German Blood and German Honor, stripping German Jews of citizenship and prohibiting marriage and relations between Jews and non-Jews.
events.significance: The laws institutionalized racial discrimination and persecution, laying the legal groundwork for the escalating persecution of Jews that culminated in the Holocaust.

events.title: 16th Street Baptist Church Bombing in Birmingham
events.description: A bomb planted by Ku Klux Klan members exploded at the 16th Street Baptist Church in Birmingham, Alabama, killing four African American girls: Addie Mae Collins, Denise McNair, Carole Robertson, and Cynthia Wesley.
events.significance: The attack galvanized national outrage and support for the civil rights movement, helping build momentum for passage of the Civil Rights Act of 1964.

events.title: Lehman Brothers Files for Bankruptcy
events.description: Lehman Brothers, the fourth-largest investment bank in the United States, filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy protection after failing to secure a buyer or government rescue, in the largest bankruptcy filing in U.S. history.
events.significance: The collapse intensified the global financial crisis, triggering severe market turmoil, government bailouts, and a worldwide recession known as the Great Recession.
